test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The business operates ________ the same way as the other businesses did.
solution:
The correct answer is '**much**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**much**" is an appropriate adverb here to indicate the extent or degree of similarity in the way the business operates compared to other businesses.
 
• The other options are grammatically incorrect or do not fit the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The business operates **much**__ the same way as the other businesses did."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "very"** is incorrect because it typically modifies adjectives or other adverbs, not verbs in this context.
 
• **Option 2: "had"** is incorrect as it is not an adverb and does not fit the context.
 
• **Option 3: "such"** is incorrect because it typically modifies nouns, not verbs in this context.
